headline: Music Streaming Service Tidal to Ban AI-Generated Music in Industry First
summary: Music streaming platform Tidal announced it will become the first in the industry to completely ban AI-generated music, effective December 9.
why: Copyright protection and content moderation policies in music streaming impact royalty distribution and relations with major record labels.

impacts.name: Streaming Sector
impacts.why: Content policy restrictions alter how streaming platforms handle automated and synthetic audio assets.
